name: Retraced Time

generation.requested_mark: Two short parallel trails of three tiny ochre pebbles, with faint chalk strokes, on empty rock.
generation.finishing: Only the generated empty-rock patch was retained using the existing line-1 PNG/JPEG helper. No ancestral figure or pigment mark lies within the patch.

visual_review.method: Inspected the final full PNG and the 512-pixel JPEG with view_image.
visual_review.pepe: Ancestral wide mouth and heavy-lidded eyes preserved pixel for pixel.
visual_review.hands: No hands or handprints added; ancestral hands concealed; zero visible hand digits.
visual_review.limitation: Human-style visual inspection by the worker, not automatic visual certification.

checks.cli: Packed synthetic fixtures, deleted scratch originals, verified exact replay and trusted digest; changed report and changed pack digest rejected with exit 2.

limitations: Examples are synthetic, not an actual incident.
Replay proves internal consistency; authenticity requires an independently trusted digest and trustworthy evidence collection.
Clock bounds remain analyst assertions, not measurements.
